backlog.description: Build Orziben with Andrew.
backlog.notes: Agreed so far: tied for largest Luric town; earthen wall; the most Imazurani town in the Luric; ruled by an Imazurani council run like a crime family (Sopranos model); slightly drier, semi-arid climate and Imazurani architecture; Malac Schismatic pilgrims from across the Luric and from Velgroth pass through. The Mountain of Fire lies east of Imazuran, about 120 miles, mostly through settled, internally peaceful country (Imazuran a paramountcy). Exports wine, olive oil, alum; smiths buy charcoal; Imazuran caravans arriving less often; its Orthodox cleric has died. Draft written 2026-10-06 (status in_development): orziben.json plus NPC stubs Amastan ut Idir, Maza ut Idir, Haelis Corran, Cerin, Sarit n'Khaleb, Doran Vell, Ysolde Fenn. Awaiting Andrew's review.
